answer: A workable design: anchor each identity to a chain event only an independent operator could cite. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The vertex of work and the prism of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a copper to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
